question: Identify the synonym of 'Acumen'
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Brilliance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Acumen"** refers to the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, typically in a specific domain, such as business or politics. (तीव्र बुद्धि, समझ)
 
 
 
• **Example: **Her business acumen has helped her company grow exponentially in the last five years.
 
 
 
• **"Brilliance"** is a synonym for "Acumen" and refers to exceptional intelligence, skill, or expertise in a particular field. (प्रतिभा)
